causal_hypothesis: Reopening alone cannot supply a pink-target spatial correction. A measured pink-label RGB-D pregrasp may restore nominal acquisition.

critic_rules.proposal: Interrupt sustained empty closure far from target; reopen then review fresh measurements before one bounded VLA chunk.
critic_rules.title: Sustained empty closure before approach

mechanism_change: Target-labelled proposal, fresh IK/TCP review, bounded measured pregrasp and target-specific VLA reentry.

recovery_rules.fallback: Record failure and end the attempt. Use existing verified homing/unload cleanup; do not bypass review or silently switch engines.
recovery_rules.precondition: Frozen far-empty-closed critic gates; fresh current must not suggest an object is held before opening.
safety_constraints: Only the gateway executes motor targets.
Fresh single-use tokens, joint limits and step budgets are enforced.
No automatic opening if current suggests an object may be held.
TCP clearance is not a full arm/finger collision certificate.
Supervised commissioning; delivered unvalidated configuration has motion disabled.

steps.stop_when: Fresh pink target cloud and metric proposal are recorded.
Fresh same-target joint IK and TCP clearance are eligible.
Measured TCP reaches pregrasp; sent commands and feedback are recorded separately.
Same-target measured pregrasp, healthy sensors and critic clearance permit reentry.
One bounded fresh VLA chunk or runtime terminal verdict.

recovery_rules.stop_condition: Pink-target 1cm lift held for five fresh frames ends success; honor runtime budgets.
recovery_rules.title: Reacquire the observed pink target

validation_plan: Retained RGB-D replay, then supervised matched parent/candidate rollouts with unchanged VLA and exposure, including colour-position swaps. Promotion requires pink-target lift of 1cm for five fresh frames and regression checks. No physical validation yet.
